resolution: <permission>/<slot path>.<ext> — an image made for that one permission profile
_common/<slot path>.<ext> — one image valid for every permission profile (preferred)
otherwise the pending placeholder renders in its place
convention.extensions: png, jpg, jpeg, svg, webp or gif — the slot never names one
convention.preferShared: deliver to _common/ unless the screen genuinely differs by deployment — six copies of one icon are six things to update
